output.reason: A 33-year-old requests a refill of hormonal contraception she reports using for three years without problems, which needs clinician prescribing review but reports no time-sensitive or concerning features.
output.patientMessage: I've asked a Counsel clinician to review your contraceptive refill in this thread; prescribing needs a clinician decision. Please reply with the exact product name and dose, and whether you have any pills left, since that affects timing. If you're close to running out, keep a backup method available. Contact a clinician promptly if you develop new migraine with visual aura, chest pain, leg swelling, or unusual vaginal bleeding.
